title: HTTP/3 WebSocket Keepalive Payload Verification
verification_method: Focused HTTP/3 loopback test, adjacent RFC 9220 regression tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene.
scope: This verification covers an accepted websocket Extended CONNECT tunnel with a configured keepalive interval and configured keepalive ping payload. The client observes the configured server ping payload, sends a pong with the same payload, sends later text data, and receives the handler response on the same tunnel.
preconditions: The received ping/pong helper boundary remains trace-owned by `VER-QUIC-RFC9220-0005`.
Manual server ping helper behavior remains trace-owned by `VER-QUIC-RFC9220-0008`.
Automatic keepalive scheduling remains trace-owned by `VER-QUIC-RFC9220-0010`.
expected_result: The focused configured-payload and adjacent WebSocket regression tests pass, the new RFC 9220 keepalive payload requirement is trace-clean, SpecTrace validation accepts the artifacts, and diff hygiene is clean.
status_summary: The HTTP/3 server handler path now has locally verified configured keepalive ping payloads on accepted RFC 9220 tunnels while preserving later tunnel data. Evidence class is local same-process loopback over the repository QUIC transport; it is not external peer interoperability, published ProtocolLab evidence, or isolated-host proof.
